description: This source file defines the PdfMetadata class, which represents an XML metadata stream within a PDF document. It includes methods to initialize metadata, generate XMP metadata content, and set up the stream with UTF-8 encoding and special characters.

classes.name: PdfMetadata
classes.description: A sealed class that inherits from PdfDictionary, representing an XML Metadata stream in a PDF document.

methods.name: PdfMetadata
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the metadata dictionary with type and subtype, and setting up the stream.

methods.name: PdfMetadata
methods.description: Parameterized constructor associating the metadata with a specific PdfDocument, adding it to the document's internal objects.

methods.name: SetupStream
methods.description: Prepares the metadata stream, encodes it in UTF-8, and inserts special byte sequences for UTF-8 BOM preservation.

methods.name: GenerateXmp
methods.description: Generates the XMP metadata string content, including document info, GUIDs, date, and optional PDF/A conformance info.

methods.name: Foo
methods.description: An additional method demonstrating the creation of a sample XMP string, possibly for testing purposes.

methods.name: SpecifyLocalDateTimeKindIfUnspecified
methods.description: Ensures DateTime objects have a local kind before formatting, avoiding ambiguity in timestamp metadata.
